title: Master Feedback
description: Configurable band-condition neurofeedback with presets for the existing programs.

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Starting band-condition set to load into the master program.

threshold_window_sec.label: Threshold window
threshold_window_sec.description: Rolling window used to recompute adaptive thresholds.

clarity_at_threshold.label: Threshold drive
clarity_at_threshold.description: Reserved threshold drive setting shared with older reward/inhibit runtimes.

quality_gate.label: Quality gate
quality_gate.description: Minimum quality score allowed for reward and calibration.

artifact_gate.label: Artifact gate
artifact_gate.description: Maximum artifact fraction allowed for reward and calibration.

gate_rewards_on_quality.label: Gate reward on quality
gate_rewards_on_quality.description: Block reward audio when quality is below the quality gate.

gate_rewards_on_artifacts.label: Gate reward on artifacts
gate_rewards_on_artifacts.description: Block reward audio when artifact fraction is at or above the artifact gate.

gate_inhibits_on_quality.label: Gate inhibits on quality
gate_inhibits_on_quality.description: When enabled, low quality also suppresses inhibit activation.

gate_inhibits_on_artifacts.label: Gate inhibits on artifacts
gate_inhibits_on_artifacts.description: When enabled, artifacts also suppress inhibit activation.
